rows.text: The inventor of JoyStream TV proclaimed it the greatest innovation ever, comparing it to a beacon of light in the dark, providing some entertainment to mundane stretches of daily life. But why should it just be a little bit? Entertainment should be life itself! With a simple click of the remote, even super-galactic explosions could be turned into entertainment shows. However, this marketing strategy proved disastrously shortsighted. By the time the IPC completed its risk assessment, it was too late. JoyStream TV had caused nearly a hundred worlds to regress into primitive societies, their inhabitants hopelessly mesmerized by their screens.
